source: Generic knock-in leg socket: one blind bore per leg in the underside of the bottom, the socket is knocked in and the leg plugs into it. socket_d, socket_depth, the adjusting range and the foot Ø are TYPICAL PLACEHOLDER VALUES, not taken from any manufacturer's data sheet: measure the socket of the leg you use (e.g. the knock-in legs of your supplier) and set them before machining.
